Hello,
I am a 4th year PhD at EPFL working on information theory. I have developed an information theory library called LeanInfoTheory and released v0.1.0 (https://github.com/serhatemrecoban/LeanInfoTheory). The first version contains discrete info heory basics and it is built on mathlib PMF's.
I am thinking that upstreaming some of the basic entropy and mutual information results is a a good idea. KL divergence is already defined in mathlib, and we can describe Shannon entropy and mutual information in terms of KL divergence as follows:
1) Entropy of a distribution p can be written in terms of KL divergence between p and a uniform distributon over an alphabet of size s(namely u_s):
H(p) = log s - D(p || u_s)
2) Mutual info between random variables with the joint distribution p_XY can be written as the KL divergence between the joint distribution p_XY and the product of the marginals p_X p_Y:
I(X;Y) = H(p_X) + H(p_Y) -H(p_XY) = D(p_XY || p_X p_Y)

I think upstreaming the basic definitions together with these identities and information theoric bounds (non-negative and upper bounded by log s for entropy and nonnegativity of mutual information) will be a very good idea. They can be upstreamed together with the equality cases for the entropy and mutual information (as independency being the necessary and sufficient condition for mutual information to be zero).

These identities are already in KL bridge module of LeanInfoTheory (https://github.com/serhatemrecoban/LeanInfoTheory/blob/v0.1.0/LeanInfoTheory/Shannon/SemanticBridge/KL.lean) and the results related to the equality cases are also in LeanInfoTheory. Also, I used AI assistance (codex) in my code development.

I am aware of the entropy work in Ploynomial Freiman Ruzsa project, and also aware of #43104 (https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/pull/43104). I want to build on these instead of repeating. Also, my current interface is using mathlib's PMF and works for finite alphabet information theory, but I am open to adapt. Moreover, I am planning to extend LeanInfoTheory's interface to make it support infinite alphabet information theory too.
Lmk what you think about whether these would be a useful first contibutions. Also, lmk if there is an existing upstream effort related to information theory. Thank you so much.
I think it would be good to get some of these basic info theory things into mathlib
